main_text.l: Diuiditur autem extribus functionibus mentis Tab.38. expressis in tres partes, quarum
Prima, directrix conceptus, seu cogitationis simplicis, mediante Termino simplici, qui vel
Dictionis: qui vel Explicatio vocis, vt
Rei: qui vel Resoluens, & hic tum Definitio. Tab.60.
Confentes, qui rursus Consentaneus: vt, Identitas rerum. Tab.62.
Dissentaneus, vt Diuerfitas, seu distinctio. Tab.63.
Secunda directrix conceptus compositi. Vide Tab.65.
Modus, quo res in praedicamenta admittuntur. Confule Tab.5.
Gradus vulgo praedicabilia, quibus res in praedicam. intelliguntur allae aliis superiores. Tab.6.
Accidentium: Absolutorum, vt: Quantitatis. Tab.14. fin.18.
Secundarium: vt, Quando, Vbi, Situs, Habitus.
Adhaerens: Adiacens: vt: Connexum, Circumstantia, Adiunctum. Obiectum.
Antecedens, Consequens, Vtrumque vel Necessarium, Contingens.

page.notes: Diagram pages: the layout is a synopsis tree with braces, not running text; boxes are given one line each with approximate depth. Cut-off labels at the left edge of Tabula I (partly lost) and of Tabula II (e.g. "Series Praedicamentalis", "Terminus circa rem") are only partly legible. The left-edge fragment "Cognitio" is doubtful. Bracket-joined words in Tabula I, such as "Primus", "Dictionis" and "Rei", were read from the scan with uncertainty about their exact nesting. Some numbers in Tabula II (fin.18, fin.31, fin.39, fin.45, fin.48) are not certain. Faint background text (ghosted title letters) is not transcribed.
